subject: Evening stress test: voucher request for throughput validation

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evening stress test: voucher request for throughput validation
Attachments: Beacon_POC_test_plan.pdf (application/pdf), beacon_load_profile.csv (text/csv)

Hi team,

BeaconAI just asked if we can enable a short, evening safety voucher to run a throughput-focused POC this Friday (11/6) between 8pm-11pm PT. Summary: they want to validate end-to-end latency at peak QPS and test our KV-prefix caching under realistic client traffic. Key targets they shared:
- Target sustained RPS: 1,200 (spikes to 1,800 for 2–3 minutes)
- Sequence lengths: avg ~220 tokens, p95 ~640 tokens
- Goal: p50 < 90ms, p95 < 320ms for text-generation routes

They requested temporary credits (or a voucher) to ensure we don’t throttle during the window. Attached is their trimmed test plan and the load profile. Can we provision a sandbox voucher (hosted tier) for the evening run, say up to 60k tokens / equivalent credit, and enable region routing to us-west for consistent latency? If we prefer dedicated capacity gating, flag that too — their ask is for hosted but they can pivot.

If Finance/Ops need more data, Beacon will share the harness endpoint and account ID (they said they can provide immediately). TL;DR: short-lived credit + a heads-up on routing/limits so the experiment isn’t artificially constrained.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evening stress test: voucher request for throughput validation

Jonas — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. A few quick clarifying Qs before Ops issues any provisional voucher: 
1) Confirm BeaconAI account id with us (HubSpot deal notes reference acct_beaconai_42 but I need their internal token/account id to map in the console).
2) Do they need any cross-region fallback active? You mentioned us-west only, but if we keep global fallback it could route to eu-west under rare congestion — will that break their harness?
3) Estimated total token consumption for the 3-hour window (approx) — your 60k figure looks conservative given their RPS + seq len; please confirm.

Operationally I can provision a temporary voucher for hosted API usage up to a provisional limit of 75,000 tokens for the 11/6 20:00–23:00 PT window, pending confirmation of account id and final load numbers. If they require dedicated capacity we need to escalate to infra and that will take longer (not guaranteed for an evening window).

If Jonas can reply with the account id and confirm no fallback to other regions, I will:
- create a voucher code in the billing console bound to BeaconAI account id
- set soft alerting at 60% and hard cut at 100% of the voucher
- add a one-off bypass for per-route throttling during the window

I'll also open a quick Ops ticket and add Marissa for visibility on capacity/tracing.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Revenue Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
